examples.label: example01 — Hall conductivity (1410.8140)
examples.notes: Physics paper, no "References" heading, equations numbered (N).

examples.label: example02 — Math/CS paper (2401.12345)
examples.notes: Math/CS paper with theorems, definitions, corollaries; bibliography with [N] markers.

semantic_backends.label: regex (stdlib, fast)
semantic_backends.notes: Deterministic regex on extracted text; high recall on figure/equation/bibliography.

semantic_backends.label: GROBID (Java service)
semantic_backends.notes: ML-based citation parser; best for scholarly articles with proper bibliography.

semantic_backends.label: DeepSeek-VL2 (v4 prompt)
semantic_backends.notes: Vision-language model; works on page images. v4 prompt drops math types from the default.

semantic_backends.label: consensus (regex ∪ grobid ∪ vlm_v4)
semantic_backends.notes: Best-of-confidence merge of all three semantic backends via merge_graphs. The Plan 7 mixer down-weights GROBID on book-class inputs so regex/VLM win more tie-breaks.
